THE FIELD GUIDE

Find your wings.

Fly upward through an endless garden with no level-clear screens. Dodge wasps flying sideways as the difficulty increases with distance. Your chosen background stays equipped.

← / →

Hold a button to steerHold the left or right arrow button to move that way. You can steer and hold Fly at the same time. Keyboard: ← → or A / D.

SPACE / ↑

Hold to flyRelease to descend. Leaves give you a bounce and a safe place to return.

3 LIVES

Carry your lives forwardStart with three lives. There are no extra lives or level resets. Lose a life and you revive automatically at your last leaf, with brief protection.

FLOWER SHOP

Pick a permanent gardenEvery bloom adds one flower to your bank. Twilight and Classic are free. Unlock Flower Garden for 60 flowers or Glowwood for 120. Equip any owned garden for all your levels. Unlocks and flowers are saved on this device.

P / ESC

Take a breatherThe game pauses when you switch away.

Each flower also earns 10 honey for your run score. See how far you can fly. Banked flowers and unlocked gardens survive losing a life, game over, and starting a new run. A new run starts with three lives.
